BG-R067.observation: GPU BG2 with native threshold 0.67f; Python helper BG1 with threshold 2/3. The impact on final TB is unverified.

root_cause_hypotheses.hypothesis: Check whether wrapper and native rate thresholds can explain the boundary observation.

suggested_investigation.action: Compare the helper threshold and native float conversion at the boundary.

assessments.uncertainty: Hypotheses require reproduction and human review. Execution status remains authoritative.

FAULT-RM-FLIP.observation: Controlled single-bit RM difference; LDPC recovered the payload and final TB CRC was zero.

root_cause_hypotheses.hypothesis: Check whether the injected bit difference explains RM evidence and decoder recovery.

suggested_investigation.action: Replay the orthogonal RM bit check before decoding.

assessments.uncertainty: Hypotheses require reproduction and human review. Execution status remains authoritative.

FAULT-CRC-FLIP.observation: Controlled post-decode payload corruption was detected by the native CRC checker.

root_cause_hypotheses.hypothesis: Check whether the controlled pre-CRC flip explains the CRC syndrome.

suggested_investigation.action: Compare decoded and deliberately modified bits before the native CRC check.

assessments.uncertainty: Hypotheses require reproduction and human review. Execution status remains authoritative.

P05-DMRS-FAULT.observation: CONTROLLED FAULT-DMRS-CONFIG: RX-only DMRS mismatch changed CRC/payload in 8/8 pairs.

root_cause_hypotheses.hypothesis: Check whether RX pilot-reference mismatch explains the paired payload outcome.

suggested_investigation.action: Inspect clean and altered receive pilot IDs for the saved IQ.

assessments.uncertainty: Hypotheses require reproduction and human review. Execution status remains authoritative.

P05-NOISE-FAULT.observation: CONTROLLED FAULT-NOISE-VARIANCE: active LLRs changed; BLER impact has not been established.

root_cause_hypotheses.hypothesis: Check whether the equalizer input bias explains the paired LLR magnitude change.

suggested_investigation.action: Repeat clean and biased equalization on identical IQ, then compare active LLR values.

assessments.uncertainty: Hypotheses require reproduction and human review. Execution status remains authoritative.

P03-SMOKE-LOW.observation: Low-SNR CRC/payload errors are observations from a small statistical sample.

root_cause_hypotheses.hypothesis: Check whether sampling at low SNR explains the observed error counts.

suggested_investigation.action: Check the sample count, SNR definition and Wilson interval.

assessments.uncertainty: Hypotheses require reproduction and human review. Execution status remains authoritative.
